source_text: 4 IUPPITER. Iuppiter hic natus in insula Creta Saturno Ut fuit adultus, patrem de regno priuauit. Proinde nobilium uxores sororesque delusit. Praeterea sceptra fecerat faber ille Piragmon. Initium caelum, terram Deus et mare fecit; Terribilis autem iste medio tempore natus Ex antro processit iuuenis furtimque nutritus. Respice querellas: Alter est Deus, non Iouis ille.
pass_a_gloss: Iuppiter in Creta; patrem priuauit. Principio Deus caelum/terram/mare. Iuuenis de spelunca — auctor omnium Deus, non Iuppiter.
pass_b_english: This Jupiter was born to Saturn on the island of Crete; and when grown he robbed his father of the kingdom. Then he deluded nobles’ wives and sisters. Moreover Pyracmon the smith had made him a scepter. In the beginning God made the heaven, the earth, and the sea. But that frightful creature, born in mid-time, went out as a youth from a cave and was nourished by stealth. Behold, that God is author of all things — not that Jupiter.
